[size=3]------------------------------------------------------------ ------About Spirites Update Plan------------------------------------------------------------------------------ [/size]
[center][size=2][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/26111/26111-1792308830-1886127197.png[/img][/size][/center]
[size=2]其实最开始我是不想画精灵贴图的，因为我作为一个modder之前，我首先是一个喜欢蔚蓝档案并且希望提升自己绘画水平的绘画爱好者，因此我的关注点更多是在如何把头像画的好看，而不是去纠结一个16*32的贴图里怎么去点一些颜色。不过鸡窝谷从最开始的b站专栏，发展到成为一个个零散的mod时，就有一些喜欢这个idea的朋友，对小人有着比较高的呼声。当时我觉得，哎好麻烦，但是从mod完整性上来看，嗯好像确实应该画。
从那时起奠定了鸡窝谷的更新逻辑，再到我将他们整合，一次更新到现在，审美和绘画水平的提升让我意识到以前画的小人还是存在许多问题，于是就有了这个翻新的计划，毕竟对美的追求，无论是头像还是精灵图，都是适用的嘛。
如你们所见，这是一张我目前为止全部画出来的小人，包括已更新的，也包括未更新的，其中，有的已经完成了重绘，有点还没有，如红圈所示都是我会在下个阶段进行重新绘制的。当然，重绘也不代表完全没问题，只是说到目前为止，我应该只能画成这个样子，尽力了说是。
以及有的朋友也说过，关于小人要不要画眉毛、脸的画法等等。关于前者，眉毛有时候确实会让脸部的结构更加硬朗，但是同样的也会让一些温柔类型的角色显得比较锐利，而如果是弯型眉毛+1格高度的眼睛，虽然会让角色产生柔弱感，但同时也会产生一种厌恶（？）感，我认为类似于伊洛玛丽、春园舜这类的角色，始终眯着眼睛并不是一个最好的方案，最终才敲定了这个不画眉毛的版本。其他角色的设计逻辑也是这样的。然后关于脸的画法，嗯，你可以理解为这是minecraft风格？感觉还可以吧，就是侧面小人方方的，是有点逗，但是如果画星露谷那个雷霆大鼻子，又不是很好看XD
最后如果你们想使用这些小人，和我说一下就行。
玩的开心！[/size]

[size=2]Actually, at the very beginning I didn’t want to draw sprite textures, because before being a modder, I was first and foremost an art hobbyist who likes Blue Archive and wants to improve my drawing skills. So my focus was more on how to make the portraits look good, rather than agonizing over how to place a few colors in a 16x32 sprite. However, when KivoValley went from being a Bilibili column at the start to developing into a bunch of separate mods, some friends who liked the idea started speaking up quite strongly for the chibi sprites. At the time I thought, ugh, what a hassle, but from the perspective of mod completeness, hmm, it did seem like I should draw them after all.
That laid down KivoValley’s update logic from then on. Later I integrated them and did a single update up to now. Improvements in my taste and drawing skills made me realize that the chibi sprites I drew before still had many problems, so this renovation plan came about. After all, the pursuit of beauty applies whether it’s portraits or sprites.
As you can see, this is an image of all the chibi sprites I’ve drawn so far, including both updated and not-yet-updated ones. Some have already been redrawn, and some haven’t yet. Those marked with red circles are the ones I’ll redraw in the next stage. Of course, redrawing doesn’t mean they’re completely problem-free. It’s just that, up to now, this is probably as good as I can draw them—I’ve done my best, so to speak.
Also, some friends have mentioned things like whether the chibi sprites should have eyebrows, how the face should be drawn, and so on. As for the former: eyebrows can indeed sometimes make the facial structure look firmer, but they can likewise make some gentle-type characters look sharper. And if I used curved eyebrows plus one-pixel-tall eyes, although it would give the character a delicate feel, it would also create a kind of disgusted (?) feeling. I think for characters like Iochi Mari and Harusono Shun, having their eyes constantly narrowed isn’t the best solution, so in the end I settled on this no-eyebrow version. The design logic for other characters is the same. Then as for how the face is drawn—well, you can think of it as Minecraft style? I think it’s okay. The side-view chibi is a bit square, which is a little funny, but if I drew that thunderous big nose from Stardew Valley, it wouldn’t look very good either XD
Lastly, if you want to use these sprites, just let me know. Have fun! [/size]
